t: 约翰·威尔克斯因煽动诽谤被英国下议院开除.
te: John Wilkes is expelled from the British House of Commons for seditious libel.
dz: 约翰·威尔克斯因煽动诽谤被英国下议院开除.
de: John Wilkes is expelled from the British House of Commons for seditious libel.

t: Bolle Willum Luxdorph在日记中记载,一个邮件炸弹,可能是世界上第一个邮件炸…
te: Bolle Willum Luxdorph records in his diary that a mail bomb, possibly the world's first, has severely injured the Danis…
dz: Bolle Willum Luxdorph在日记中记载,一个邮件炸弹,可能是世界上第一个邮件炸弹,使住在Børglum Abbey的丹麦上校Poulsen受了重伤.
de: Bolle Willum Luxdorph records in his diary that a mail bomb, possibly the world's first, has severely injured the Danish Colonel Poulsen, residing at Børglum Abbey.

t: 圣路易斯市建于西班牙路易斯安那州(现为美国密苏里州).
te: The city of St. Louis is established in Spanish Louisiana (now in Missouri, USA).
dz: 圣路易斯市建于西班牙路易斯安那州(现为美国密苏里州).
de: The city of St. Louis is established in Spanish Louisiana (now in Missouri, USA).

t: 历史上最强烈的龙卷风之一袭击了德国的沃尔德克(Woldegk),造成一人死亡,同时用估计超过每…
te: One of the strongest tornadoes in history strikes Woldegk, Germany, killing one person while leveling numerous mansions…
dz: 历史上最强烈的龙卷风之一袭击了德国的沃尔德克(Woldegk),造成一人死亡,同时用估计超过每小时300英里(480公里/小时)的风力将多座豪宅夷平.
de: One of the strongest tornadoes in history strikes Woldegk, Germany, killing one person while leveling numerous mansions with winds estimated greater than 300 miles per hour (480 km/h).

dz: 选举斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基为波兰-立陶宛联邦的最后一位统治者.
